_comment: Committed metrics for Suite B: integers and dimensionless ratios only, which hold on any host given the pinned settings. Host-dependent timings (wall-clock, CPU per row) are deliberately absent - they are compared run-local via AI_E2E_COMPARE_TO, the way ci/jobs/scripts/perf/compare.sh compares two binaries on one runner. Regenerate with AI_E2E_WRITE_BASELINES=1 and review the diff; never hand-edit.
